name: naabu
summary: A fast port scanner written in go with focus on reliability and simplicity.
highlights: -l — list of hosts to scan ports (file)
-exclude-hosts — hosts to exclude from the scan (comma-separated)
-exclude-file — list of hosts to exclude from scan (file)
-port-threshold — port threshold to skip port scan for the host
-exclude-cdn — skip full port scans for CDN/WAF (only scan for port 80,443)

flags.name: -list
flags.description: list of hosts to scan ports (file)

flags.name: -exclude-hosts
flags.description: hosts to exclude from the scan (comma-separated)

flags.name: -exclude-file
flags.description: list of hosts to exclude from scan (file)

flags.name: -port
flags.description: ports to scan (80,443, 100-200)

flags.name: -top-ports
flags.description: top ports to scan (default 100) [full,100,1000]

flags.name: -port-threshold
flags.description: port threshold to skip port scan for the host

flags.name: -exclude-cdn
flags.description: skip full port scans for CDN/WAF (only scan for port 80,443)

flags.name: -display-cdn
flags.description: display cdn in use

flags.name: -c
flags.description: general internal worker threads (default 25)

flags.name: -rate
flags.description: packets to send per second (default 1000)

flags.name: -update
flags.description: update naabu to latest version

flags.name: -disable-update-check
flags.description: disable automatic naabu update check

flags.name: -output
flags.description: file to write output to (optional)

flags.name: -list-output-fields
flags.description: list of fields to output (comma separated)

flags.name: -json
flags.description: write output in JSON lines format

flags.name: -csv
flags.description: write output in csv format

flags.name: -config
flags.description: path to the naabu configuration file (default $HOME/.config/naabu/config.yaml)

flags.name: -scan-all-ips
flags.description: scan all the IP's associated with DNS record

flags.name: -scan-type
flags.description: type of port scan (SYN/CONNECT) (default "c")

flags.name: -source-ip
flags.description: source ip and port (x.x.x.x:yyy - might not work on OSX)

flags.name: -connect-payload
flags.description: payload to send in CONNECT scans (optional)

flags.name: -interface-list
flags.description: list available interfaces and public ip

flags.name: -interface
flags.description: network Interface to use for port scan

flags.name: -nmap
flags.description: invoke nmap scan on targets (nmap must be installed) - Deprecated

flags.name: -nmap-cli
flags.description: nmap command to run on found results (example: -nmap-cli 'nmap -sV')

flags.name: -r
flags.description: list of custom resolver dns resolution (comma separated or from file)

flags.name: -proxy
flags.description: socks5 proxy (ip[:port] / fqdn[:port]

flags.name: -proxy-auth
flags.description: socks5 proxy authentication (username:password)

flags.name: -dns-order
flags.description: dns resolution order (p/l/lp/pl) (default "l")

flags.name: -system-resolver
flags.description: use system DNS as fallback resolver

flags.name: -resume
flags.description: resume scan using resume.cfg

flags.name: -stream
flags.description: stream mode (disables resume, nmap, verify, retries, shuffling, etc)

flags.name: -passive
flags.description: display passive open ports using shodan internetdb api

flags.name: -input-read-timeout
flags.description: timeout on input read (default 3m0s)

flags.name: -no-stdin
flags.description: Disable Stdin processing

flags.name: -host-discovery
flags.description: Perform Only Host Discovery

flags.name: -skip-host-discovery
flags.description: Skip Host discovery

flags.name: -with-host-discovery
flags.description: Enable Host discovery

flags.name: -probe-icmp-echo
flags.description: ICMP echo request Ping (host discovery needs to be enabled)

flags.name: -probe-icmp-timestamp
flags.description: ICMP timestamp request Ping (host discovery needs to be enabled)

flags.name: -probe-icmp-address-mask
flags.description: ICMP address mask request Ping (host discovery needs to be enabled)

flags.name: -arp-ping
flags.description: ARP ping (host discovery needs to be enabled)

flags.name: -nd-ping
flags.description: IPv6 Neighbor Discovery (host discovery needs to be enabled)

flags.name: -rev-ptr
flags.description: Reverse PTR lookup for input ips

flags.name: -service-discovery
flags.description: Service Discovery

flags.name: -service-version
flags.description: Service Version

flags.name: -retries
flags.description: number of retries for the port scan (default 3)

flags.name: -timeout
flags.description: millisecond to wait before timing out (default 1s)

flags.name: -warm-up-time
flags.description: time in seconds between scan phases (default 2)

flags.name: -ping
flags.description: ping probes for verification of host

flags.name: -verify
flags.description: validate the ports again with TCP verification

flags.name: -smart-scan
flags.description: predictive port scanning using port correlation model

flags.name: -prediction-threshold
flags.description: minimum confidence for port predictions (0-100%) (default 20)

flags.name: -health-check
flags.description: run diagnostic check up

flags.name: -debug
flags.description: display debugging information

flags.name: -verbose
flags.description: display verbose output

flags.name: -no-color
flags.description: disable colors in CLI output

flags.name: -silent
flags.description: display only results in output

flags.name: -version
flags.description: display version of naabu

flags.name: -stats
flags.description: display stats of the running scan (deprecated)

flags.name: -stats-interval
flags.description: number of seconds to wait between showing a statistics update (deprecated) (default 5)

flags.name: -metrics-port
flags.description: port to expose naabu metrics on (default 63636)

flags.name: -auth
flags.description: configure projectdiscovery cloud (pdcp) api key (default true)

flags.name: -auth-config
flags.description: configure projectdiscovery cloud (pdcp) api key credential file

flags.name: -dashboard
flags.description: upload / view output in projectdiscovery cloud (pdcp) UI dashboard

flags.name: -team-id
flags.description: upload asset results to given team id (optional)

flags.name: -asset-id
flags.description: upload new assets to existing asset id (optional)

flags.name: -asset-name
flags.description: assets group name to set (optional)

flags.name: -dashboard-upload
flags.description: upload naabu output file (jsonl) in projectdiscovery cloud (pdcp) UI dashboard
